prompt:
Image 1 is the floor plan of this room seen from above: its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall. Generate one photorealistic cinematic still of this room, the front view (the establishing view): the camera stands at the centre of the front wall, at eye level, facing the back wall, with a 35mm lens and natural textures. The room layout and furniture placement should exactly match Image 1. The place is completely empty of people: no person, figure, silhouette, mannequin or reflection of a person anywhere, including behind glass, through doorways and in the distance. Location: INT. JI RAN'S LIVING ROOM. A spacious, stylish contemporary downtown apartment living room at night, in pale stone, warm oak and glass. Back wall: floor-to-ceiling windows with sheer curtains and a glittering night city view, which gives a cool glow from behind. Left wall: the opening to the entrance hallway, the way in, and a large abstract canvas. Right wall: an open-plan kitchen with white cabinetry and a long marble island with three bar stools, lit by a pendant above. In the middle of the room, on a large patterned rug, a long pale-oatmeal sofa stands with its back to the left wall, facing the open kitchen on the right wall. In front of it is a low marble-and-glass coffee table, with open floor between the coffee table and the kitchen island. Front wall, behind the camera: a low TV console. Warm light also comes from a brass arc floor lamp beside the sofa and soft cove lighting in the ceiling. Show only this place as described: the doors, windows and openings it names lead nowhere new, with no other exit, courtyard, corridor or outdoor view added. Light it with the sources the description names, from their direction, at a neutral daylight white balance so that whites are white; only lamps the description names may glow warm.

Avoid: people or silhouettes, readable text, labels, signs with letters or numbers, logos, watermark.
